column26: THE ONLY MEASURED TRANSMISSION DATASET IN THE WHOLE AUDIT AND ITS RESULT IS A NULL: 'melanin does not provide improved shielding in comparison to cellulose from beta-radiation.' That is the physically expected outcome if attenuation is governed by areal density and Z, and it strips melanin of any special shielding status absent a spatial-arrangement argument. THREE REASONS IT IS NOT AN OpenMC PHOTON BENCHMARK: the modality is Sr-90 BETA, electrons and not photons; the 40 kVp X-ray case in the same archive appears in GEANT4 SIMULATION ONLY and was never measured; and the comparison engine is Geant4, not OpenMC. Agreement against it would license the statement 'the transport-comparison workflow was exercised' and nothing stronger. There is no biomass here at all — melanin in solution is not a hydrated biofilm — so it informs no material class. The 'matched elemental composition' of the control is asserted in the text and its values were not read, hence CHNS_available unverified. 13235258 B, MD5 641b6fb1...

column4: dry melanin-PLA biocomposite exposed in low Earth orbit
column26: REJECTED ON MATERIAL STATE AND ON OUTCOME. The measured outcome is polymer mass loss and surface wrinkling — DEGRADATION OF A PLASTIC — not transmitted radiation reduced by biomass, so it is not an attenuation measurement whatever its abstract suggests. The material is a dry engineered composite and every class in this ledger is HYDRATED; a dry composite cannot inform a hydrated bulk composition even in principle, because the water is the largest single mass term the classes exist to carry. The LEO exposure is additionally confounded with atomic-oxygen erosion and thermal cycling, which the abstract itself names as co-acting mechanisms.

column4: fungal biomass grown over 13.33 mm of potato dextrose agar in a Petri dish
column26: THE FLAGSHIP SHIELDING RECORD AND IT CHARACTERISES ITS OWN ATTENUATOR NOT AT ALL. No areal density, no elemental composition, no thickness of biomass separable from the 13.33 mm of agar that dominates the attenuation path, and MELANIN WAS NEVER MEASURED — the paper says 'presumably constant' and 'putatively'. The shielding result is 147 against 151 CPM, n = 1 dish, one sensor pair, p = 0.069, with the phase-1 negative control at p = 0.970. NO DOSE AXIS EXISTS: 'Due to the nature of the employed radiation sensors (PIN photodiode), dosimetric data was not obtained', and the supplement carries two mutually inconsistent count-to-dose conversions differing by 4.4x, both dividing someone else's whole-body dose rate by this detector's count rate. RECONCILIATION IS A STOP CONDITION, not a task: it needs an incident particle spectrum by species and energy at the sensor, a detector response function for the X100-7 SMD in that field, a mass model of everything between space and the diode, and the attenuator's own areal density and composition. All four are absent and supplying any of them would mean inventing it. The widely-quoted 2.17 +/- 0.25% attenuation figure exists in NO version — bioRxiv v1 says 2.17 +/- 0.35%, v7 says ~0.84%, the published article says neither — and peer review struck both 'radiotrophic' and 'radiation-shield' from the title.

UV-C AT 254 nm IS NOT IONIZING RADIATION FOR THIS PROJECT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES, and retaining it would let a UV attenuation result be read as photon shielding by biomass. It also has no mass basis: an extract in KOH at an unstated concentration gives no areal density and no mass per unit area, so even within its own modality it cannot yield an attenuation coefficient for a material.

column26: A DRY-WEIGHT DIFFERENCE BETWEEN ARMS IS NOT A DRY SOLIDS FRACTION. This is the record that earns the word radiotrophic in the sibling ledger, and it earns it on growth contrasts: dry weight +6.5% (C. neoformans, P = 0.02) and +8-10% (W. dermatitidis, P = 0.02), CFU ~2.5x, 14C-acetate ~3x. Those percentages are CHANGES BETWEEN IRRADIATED AND CONTROL ARMS, not the fraction of a hydrated biofilm that is solids, so dry_solids_fraction stays blank and this row exists to keep the two from being confused. No wet mass, no volume, no elemental set, no melanin quantification against dose. Melanin also carried a BASELINE COST here — non-irradiated non-melanized cells grew better and incorporated more 14C-acetate than non-irradiated melanized cells — so even the growth contrast is confounded by a difference present without radiation.

column4: melanized and non-melanized cells; DOPA-melanin against DHN-melanin

column26: 'MELANIN' DENOTES AT LEAST THREE DIFFERENT POLYMERS ACROSS THIS AUDIT — induced DOPA-melanin, constitutive DHN-melanin, and allomelanin — AND THIS RECORD STATES THE DISTINCTION EXPLICITLY FOR ITS OWN TWO ARMS. They differ in elemental composition, and NO RECORD IN THE AUDIT SUPPLIES AN ELEMENTAL COMPOSITION FOR ANY OF THEM, so no melanized-biofilm material composition is derivable from the located literature at all. Any future hydrated_melanized_biofilm must name which polymer, and a composition measured on one may not be carried to the other. This is also the one record where melanin measurably alters survival under an ionizing modality (deuterons, both species, p < 1e-4), and its X-ray result for C. neoformans is hedged as 'probably' — a hedge in an abstract is not a measurement — while its two metabolic proxies move in OPPOSITE directions in the same cells (XTT up, ATP down in melanized strains).

column4: melanized and DHN-knockout rock-inhabiting black fungi
column26: THE STRUCTURAL ARGUMENT AGAINST A PER-SPECIES MELANIN CONSTANT, AND THE REASON THIS LEDGER CAPS ITSELF AT THREE MATERIAL CLASSES. The same pigment was knocked out with the same gene class in two rock-inhabiting black fungi: 'DHN melanin provided UV-B protection in C. antarcticus, whereas the same pigment or even carotenoids proved ineffective in K. petricola', concluding that 'although the adaptive trait of DHN melanization commonly occurs across black fungi, it is not equally functional.' n >= 9, the best-replicated record in the audit. THE MODALITY IS UV-B SO NOTHING TRANSFERS TO THE IONIZING CASE; the structural finding does, and it is independent support for the standing prohibition 'do not create seven materials because there are seven species'. Both species are outside the seven and are retained as mechanistic surrogates only — surrogate status is enforced, not conventional.

column4: individual cells in a density gradient
column26: REFUSED. The Loferer-Krossbacher/Fagerbakke lineage supplies a 1.09 g/cm3 figure with a ~30% dry-matter figure, and BOTH ARE LEFT OUT OF THE NUMERIC COLUMNS OF THIS ROW ON PURPOSE — wet_bulk_density and dry_solids_fraction are blank because nothing measured them for a biofilm. It is a CELL BUOYANT DENSITY from density-gradient centrifugation of individual cells, while density_basis must be wet_bulk and the binding sentence assigns a HYDRATED BULK BIOFILM material to a voxel: a parcel bundles cells AND their extracellular material AND the interstitial water. A cell buoyant density excludes the matrix and the pore water and overstates the bulk by roughly the void fraction. It is dimensionally plausible, widely cited, easy to justify in a sentence, and wrong. This row exists so that the next pass finds the refusal instead of the number.

column13: cells; bound EPS; loosely associated EPS (all imported from prior literature)
column26: REFUSED. The Frontiers Env Sci 2017 concentrations (cells 224 mM, bound EPS 168 mM, loosely associated EPS 56 mM, at 113 g biomass per mole from the empirical formula C5H7O2N) are on the RIGHT BASIS and are still refused, which is the point of recording them: they are cited to Nielsen 1997 and Laspidou and Rittmann 2002, IMPORTED FROM PRIOR LITERATURE AND NOT MEASURED ON THAT SYSTEM. Under the repository's vocabulary that is evidence_basis=declared, which sits in BLOCKED_EVIDENCE, and export.problems_for() would refuse them with 'a proxy or declared composition is a placeholder, and shipping it would launder it into a measurement.' Importing them would be exactly that laundering. A second and independent failure: the measurement volume is a 2x2x2 mm3 NMR voxel, a millimetre-scale bulk-averaging volume three orders of magnitude coarser than any plausible lattice pitch.

column4: genome-scale model biomass objective function
column26: REFUSED. Genome-scale metabolic models were the ONLY route located to an S. oneidensis elemental composition, which is why the refusal is written down rather than assumed. A biomass reaction is a DECLARED STOICHIOMETRY assembled from macromolecular assumptions and frequently borrowed wholesale from E. coli, so it fails the evidence rule; it is also on a dry basis with no w_water anywhere in reach, so it fails the basis rule independently. Two failures, either one sufficient. Nothing about the ease of extracting a closing elemental vector from a GEM makes the vector a measurement.

column4: not_applicable
column26: NO CANDIDATE FOUND. No public source located in this audit pairs a wet mass, a dry mass and matched blanks with a calibrated hydrated volume, for ANY organism, under ONE growth condition — and without a hydrated volume there is no rho_wet, no X_total and no voxel binding, whatever the composition. The four near-misses each fail differently and each has its own row above. THE PAIRED EXPERIMENT MUST BE DESIGNED, on one system under one growth condition: replicate-level wet mass and dry mass with matched hydrated and dry substrate blanks; a hydrated volume on a whole_biofilm_envelope basis or a declared pore_volume_fraction; ash content; CHNS plus ICP-OES/ICP-MS closing to 1 on a WET-BULK basis; a calibrated 3D stack of the same specimen; and a characterised dose field with a measured gradient. Until then the honest state of the material table is HEADER-ONLY, and header-only is not a placeholder for invented rows. This is a search result on one date across a named set of repositories, sampled and not exhausted — it is not a proof of absence.
